page.layout: One printed page. Top: the title block, centred, in several sizes of type. Below it, at left and centred, a motto paragraph set in roman type with a pilcrow. A library stamp and a handwritten mark sit at right and are left out.

main_text.l: ¶ Et hoc præcor vt charitas vestra adhuc ma-
gis ac magis redundet,in cognitione & om-
ni sensu : vt dignoscatis quæ discrepant, vt
sitis sinceri & inoffenso cursu pergatis ad

page.notes: Title page. The Bodleian library stamp (circular, at right) and a handwritten mark beside the motto are not transcribed. The title line "Veritas quæ est secundum" and "PIETATEM" appear in mixed roman and italic type as printed. The first word of the motto block carries a pilcrow. No page number, running head or signature is printed.
